anomalies.observed: C25 is a 10 nF X7R 0603 decoupling capacitor on the isolated EC supply. Its instance carries an extra Tolerance field set to "20%" and a description "10000 pF ±20% 100V". Every other 10 nF part in the BOM (C23, C33, C35), and its own library part, specify ±10%.
anomalies.expected: A decoupling capacitor in this position should match the ±10% X7R part used for the other 10 nF capacitors in the design.
anomalies.impact: Minor. Decoupling on the isolated EC supply is slightly looser than the rest of the BOM. Probably not a functional failure, but it is a BOM inconsistency.

anomalies.observed: The gate node of the main-pump low-side MOSFET T2 (/G_PUMP) is pulled up to +3V3 through R5 (10k). The ESP32 drives it through R1 (100 Ω), and T1 can only pull it low. When the MCU pin is high-impedance, for example at boot or reset, the gate sits at 3.3 V and the 24 V main pump is enabled. By contrast, the ATO valve gate G_ATO is pulled down to GND through R12, which is the fail-safe arrangement.
anomalies.expected: A fail-safe pump gate should be pulled down to GND so the 24 V pump is off at boot, reset or MCU pin float, consistent with the pull-down used on the ATO valve gate (R12).
anomalies.impact: The main circulation pump could energise unintentionally during MCU boot, reset, or GPIO float, which is a dry-run or safety hazard for the pump.

anomalies.observed: The enable pin (EN, pin 2) of the TPS62933 24 V→5 V buck U1 is marked no-connect. It is not tied to VIN, to a resistor divider or to any control GPIO.
anomalies.expected: The TPS62933 EN pin should be tied to VIN, through a divider, or to a defined control signal, so that the converter's enable state is defined.
anomalies.impact: If the part's EN input has no internal pull, the +5 V rail, and therefore the ESP32 and the 3.3 V LDO, may fail to start reliably or may behave unpredictably.

parsed.summary: The netlist is largely self-consistent with the specification, with no shorts or obvious mis-wirings found. The most plausible deviations are a 20% tolerance on decoupling capacitor C25 against the ±10% BOM standard, a main-pump gate pulled up to +3V3 rather than down to GND (R5), and a floating buck enable pin on U1, all of which are low-to-moderate confidence.
